documents.text: Andrew McFarlane (judge) Sir Andrew Ewart McFarlane, PC (born 20 June 1954) is a British judge. He was a Lord Justice of Appeal in England and Wales from 2011 to 2018, and became President of the Family Division in July 2018 upon Sir James Munby’s retirement from that office. McFarlane was born on 30 June 1954. He was educated at Shrewsbury School and studied law at Collingwood College, Durham, and graduated from Durham University in 1975. McFarlane was called to the bar (Gray's Inn) in 1977 and has been a Bencher since 2003. In 1998, he became a Queen's Counsel.
